## Acceptance and limits

The source case rejects empty, zero-prefixed, negative and non-numeric strings before kill -0; stale files are removed and normal discovery continues. A positive decimal without a leading zero reaches the liveness check. The new table exercises all those shapes with a permissive kill stub and checks both the returned value and stale-file cleanup. The existing recovery test exercises the real host Bash5.3 path. The controlled revert restores only the pre-validation block in a disposable fresh view; all logs/BEP/XML are retained, and the original canonical bytes were restored before view cleanup.

The process-backed lane the reviewer did not run is independently included in this release's full integration-packages command with GC_FAST_UNIT=0. TestTutorial01 is required by name in the retained logs; default-unit lane-gate skips alone do not satisfy that proof.

The string check has no PID numeric-range/length bound; an oversized all-digit value remains outside this fix. Other file-sourced kill -0 seams are unchanged follow-up work. The harness does not signal a real process or prove process ownership. No live managed Dolt crash/restart, installed binary change or operator-city deployment was performed.

Historical builder RED/GREEN and reviewer mutants are attributable inputs only. This release independently ran its complete canonical suite, host acceptance and explicit RED control. The tracker remains open until MPR actually lands the fix; opening this PR does not release PR8506's hold.
